Released: 21 September 2026

WEM 1.4.0 includes new features, enhancements, and bug fixes.

## Highlights

- **ClickHouse for metrics and logs:** WEM now stores and queries all metrics and logs in ClickHouse instead of Prometheus and Loki. The **Alerts** panel and the **Logs** panel both move to this unified pipeline. See [Managing alerts](../monitoring/alerts) and [Auditing system logs](../monitoring/logs).
- **Mutual TLS for host agent connections:** Every connection between the host agent and WEM is now authenticated with mutual TLS (mTLS). WEM's internal certificate authority issues each agent a short-lived certificate and renews it automatically. See [Installing the host agent](../installing/host-agent).
- **Host agent self-registration:** Host agents register themselves with WEM on first connection instead of requiring manual enrollment. A new admin tab lets Admins approve or reject pending registrations. See [Installing the host agent](../installing/host-agent).
- **Cluster Management:** Start, stop, restart, and recover a segment (`gprecoverseg`) directly from the WEM UI, dispatched through the host agent. See [Verifying the cluster health](../monitoring/cluster-overview).
- **Backup and restore scheduling:** Schedule recurring backup and restore jobs from within WEM instead of relying on external cron jobs. See [Securing backups](../protecting-data/backups).
- **Per-action access control:** Admins can grant permissions for individual actions, such as running or deleting a backup, in addition to the existing tab-level permissions. See [Performing administrative management](../system-access/management).
- **PXF in its own tab:** PXF management moves out of **External Tables** and into a dedicated tab in **Data Analysis**, with sync and restart support. See [Analyzing data distribution](../performance/data-analysis).

## Security Fixes

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th><th width="10%">Addresses</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><details><summary>Addressed reported security issues</summary><hr/><p>Addressed reported security issues in API routes and host agent privileged-command handling, including a helper command that accepted an arbitrary file path and one that followed a world-writable path during binary discovery, and updated internal dependencies to pick up upstream security fixes.</p>
</details></td><td>446, 39, 32, 442, 433, 14</td></tr>
</tbody></table>


## Changes

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th><th width="10%">Addresses</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><details><summary>Prometheus and Loki are no longer used</summary><hr/><p>WEM's metrics and log pipeline is fully migrated to ClickHouse. The Collector no longer pushes to Prometheus or Loki, and the SQL exporter and Prometheus remote-write receiver are removed. If you're upgrading, plan to decommission any Prometheus or Loki instances you ran solely for WEM. See <a href="../installing/upgrading">Upgrading WarehousePG Enterprise Manager</a>.</p>
</details></td><td>426</td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary><code>WHPG_PXF_BIN</code> configuration parameter removed</summary><hr/><p>PXF binary discovery now always uses fixed, safe paths. If you set <code>WHPG_PXF_BIN</code> explicitly, remove it from <code>wem.conf</code> when you upgrade. See <a href="../reference/configuration">Configuration reference</a>.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Refresh controls standardized</summary><hr/><p>Refresh buttons across the application are now icon-only, with an accessible label for screen readers, instead of a mix of icon and text buttons.</p>
</details></td><td>454</td></tr>
</tbody></table>
